bugs.what: Watchtower grace checks inconsistent: rolled 7+3=10 (needed 7+) and then 5+3=8 (needed 7+) but both failed. Unclear if rolls work as 'meet or exceed' or 'strictly greater than'

confusions: Wolf encounters were hostile but didn't attack unless provoked — unclear how close I could get before 'giving cause'
The menu option 'the wind verse is still unspoken' was unclear until the king explained it referred to the watchtower
Herb hollow could be revisited or not — unclear if single-use or persistent resource
When asked 'what proof he wants,' the elder's response about 'seal' was ambiguous (did they mean the coffer was sealed or the king's seal?)
suggestions: Clarify grace/wits/will check mechanics: state whether DC 7+ means ≥7 or >7 to reduce RNG confusion
Add a tooltip or hint for 'keeper's crack' — 'search for hidden entrance' might be clearer than the specific term
Make wolf behavior more transparent: show a distance indicator or warning message at approach threshold
Consider adding a scene summary after obtaining the crown showing the barrow journey shortened, as 8 turns of pure navigation felt repetitive
